periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downward toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with vertical elongation; the height of the patch significantly exceeds its width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the lowest point of the patch extending well below the geometric center, creating a teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped profile along the posterior edge of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso length from the shoulder to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation on the cranial vault with a prominent expanse of white fur between the two dark regions.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the top of the ear boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: The lower posterior and hindquarter fur is visibly saturated and clumped, exhibiting a distinct yellowish-brown chromatic shift compared to the bright white dorsal fur.
